posts.text:
A brace for @JoeBev97 in the last game confirmed him as @SandbachUtd highest ever scorer, surpassing @James_Kirby10 previous on 54 goals. With a whole season ahead how many can he get!
Congratulations Joe on the fantastic achievement in just two seasons at the ramblers. https://t.co/B5elk2v3Xj
Back the ramblers this evening as they travel to @foley_fc in search of back to back wins and that perfect start to the season. https://t.co/sLiMLf7wAx
Thank you to BWB Landscapes based locally for sponsoring @cope_niall for the 26/27 season. Contact BWB for all of your landscaping needs. https://t.co/l41HW1cJHW
Thank you to @WednesfieldCFC for the visit, lovely bunch and great addition to the @nwcfl safe journey home folks.

Sub for the Bach,

Hamnett on for Barry
Cain goes in the book, not sure why possibly in an attempt to run the clock down.
Sub for the bach Williams for Bevan, but the sub falls foul of the new rule and is not conducted in time, Bach down to ten men for a minute.
The 90 is up but with a hydration break we have 7 added
Freekick for the opposition well struck misses the wall but Greg Hall is up to the task with a diving save to deny.
